card.name: Bullet dots and PDT in labels
card.fires_on: Bullet-point marks (· or •) that separate list items or sentences in label text, mostly in regadenoson labels. Also the abbreviation PDT (photodynamic therapy) in AMELUZ and PHOTOFRIN labels.

modes.label: Bullet dot separators
modes.description: A middle dot or bullet used as a list or sentence separator in drug label text.
modes.example: Do not administer Regadenoson injection to patients with:<< ·>> Second- or third- degree AV block

modes.label: PDT abbreviation
modes.description: The letters PDT, or the end of (PDT), for photodynamic therapy with a light-activated drug.
modes.example: IN with<< PDT>>. Do not initiate PHOTOFRIN with
